Hey Matt - looks like the list has expanded since my comment six years ago. Did you start this list? The list title "Philosophy of Mind" is a pretty specific topic area in academic philosophy so many of the books on this list don't fit the academic meaning of that title. This list has many good philosophy of mind titles but it also seems to be a conglomeration of various mind/consciousness related topics, not books specific to "philosophy of mind" - specifically, I see titles in: Consciousness studies Embodied mind cognitive science General cognitive science Analytic philosophy Depth psychology Neuroscience Buddhism Wizard of Us? No matter - there's lots of overlap when dealing with mind and consciousness topics. One warning: beware of people dumping unrelated books onto your list. The list I created "Embodied Cognition" had an author dump his books onto the list to bring attention to them so that people would buy them. I had to expunge his books several times from the list. Finally, I contacted him and threatened to report him to GoodReads if he continued. Fortunately, he stopped. Cheers!
